about:
Ambix Manufacturing, Inc. was founded in 2001 in Albany, New Hampshire. The company specializes in high-end plastics injection design, molding, and contract manufacturing.

Ambix provides full-service custom plastic injection molding, including material selection, mold design, prototyping, process design, and full contract manufacturing. The company also offers precision machining, high-temperature molding capabilities, and value-added services such as small-parts packing, sorting, and bagging in bulk or retail packs. Ambix states it has produced millions of parts and handles volumes ranging from 100 parts to millions.

The company serves customers facing supply-chain risks, new product launches, and demand increases, with case studies highlighting on-shoring of mold production to its New Hampshire facility, mold redesign for cost reduction, and automation implementation to secure raw materials. While specific industries are not listed, ITAR registration suggests defense-related work.

Ambix emphasizes fast turnarounds on prototypes, molds, and production; high-quality products the first time; and ISO 9001:2015 certification. Its differentiation lies in process optimization, failure analysis, domestic manufacturing, and a strong vendor network that enables material acquisition during supply constraints.
